parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key) VALUES ('{{ $json.dedupeKey }}')
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO transactions (correlation_id, doc_type, direction, partner, stream, status, external_ids, payload_ref)
  SELECT '{{ $json.correlationId }}', '{{ $json.docType }}', '{{ $json.direction }}', 'DCG', 'TEST', '{{ $json.status }}', '{{ $json.externalIds }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.fileName }}'
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.correlationId }}' AS correlation_id,
  (SELECT id FROM ins) IS NOT NULL AS is_new,
  (SELECT id FROM logged) AS transaction_id;

parameters.query:
UPDATE transactions
SET status = 'sent'
WHERE correlation_id = '{{ $('Reattach File + Metadata').item.json.correlationId }}'
RETURNING id, correlation_id, status;

meta.instructions: Pulls 3 real AM products + their SKUs, ports adapters/edi/x12-dcg/lib/{envelope,build888}.js into the 'Build 888 X12' Code node (Code nodes can't import repo files -- keep in sync manually), dedupes/logs to Supabase, uploads the X12 file to S3, then pushes it to DCG via the Transfer Family Connector's StartFileTransfer API. TBD/unconfirmed before a real send (see adapters/edi/x12-dcg/schema-notes.md): vendor name (N1), ISA sender/receiver IDs, division code, vendor item number scheme -- all called out inline in 'Build 888 X12'. S3 bucket 'scl-dcg-sftp-bridge' (us-east-2) is confirmed real, already created. Still TBD: whether DCG needs a specific RemoteDirectoryPath in the StartFileTransfer body (currently omitted, so the connector uses its configured default). After import, re-select credentials: Query Auth account (Get AM Products, Get AM Inventory), Postgres account (Claim & Log, Mark Sent), AWS account (Upload to S3, StartFileTransfer -- this must be an n8n AWS credential with permissions for s3:PutObject on the bucket and transfer:StartFileTransfer/transfer:ListFileTransferResults on the connector). Uses usageIndicator 'T' (test) and stream 'TEST' throughout -- flip to 'P'/'LIVE' only once DCG confirms this is a real send, and only after resolving the TBD fields above.
